approved_scope.title: A subheading inside a delta item must not flush the item: content headings split one section into fragments and the last one wins
approved_scope.description: A subheading inside a delta item must not flush the item: content headings split one section into fragments and the last one wins
acceptance_criteria: a delta declaring the same operation, target and key twice is refused rather than silently keeping the last
a delta section carrying content subheadings parses as ONE item holding all of them, not one item per subheading
a real item heading still ends the previous item, so distinct sections are not merged
the living spec no longer loses documented behaviour a change never touched
